sentences.en: But visions of gigantic piles of BB sized oats continued to plague his brain as he donned his coat and gloves to clear the steps and walk-ways of the overnight snow.

sentences.en: In our defense it was cos BB had been absolutely appalling at sleeping!

sentences.en: The genotypes BB and Bb will both give a brown-eyed baby whereas genotype bb would give a blue-eyed baby.

sentences.en: I fed BB some more - about 50th feed - and then made up stories about Maggie and the ferocious beast.

sentences.en: Small was desperately cute persuading BB to play with him.

sentences.en: So after that mostly played with the dolls house and snappit donkey until lunchtime. sometimes with BB, and sometimes most definitely not.
